thread:
Maya (Designer): small UX bug — when you reorder rules in Draft, Preview still shows saved order. users think reorder failed.
Chris (PM): can you repro? screenshots?
Maya (Designer): yes on staging, attaching GIF. The draft dot is tiny and easy to miss.
Ethan (Frontend): probably the sim call reads server snapshot. quick fix: show "Previewing draft" on the button and update legend counts client-side.
Rina (A11y): draft dot not screen reader visible. suggest a "Draft (unsaved)" pill with role=status and aria-live=polite.
Leo (Backend): long-term we can accept draft snapshots in /simulate but need size limits and rate limits.
Chris (PM): plan: ship quick UI affordance this sprint; backlog API change.
Ethan (Frontend): I'll spike small PR to render draft pill + client legend counts. aim to ship Thu.
Maya (Designer): copy options: "Draft (unsaved)" pill; banner: "You are previewing unsaved edits in this policy — Save to make them live." Validate microcopy for rules: "Missing match value — add a header or path".
Rina (A11y): tweak copy: include 'in this policy' for context. ensure pill is keyboard focusable and shortcut hints are not only in tooltips.
ci-bot: build started for branch feat/draft-preview (job #5340).
Ethan (Frontend): noted, will include a11y attributes and validation inline hints.
